subject: Medivance: temporary debug-log preservation & addendum request
messages:
From: Alice Martin <alice.martin@medivance.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@medivance.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary preservation of debug logs for incident review

Hi Karthik and Priyom,

Quick note from Legal & SecOps at Medivance. We recently had a production incident that is under an internal security review. Our forensic team needs access to a subset of debug/trace logs associated with tenant: medivance-prod (session IDs listed in the attached CSV) and we'd like Redwood to preserve those logs for 90 days rather than your standard 30d ephemeral TTL.

We understand this is customer-scoped and may require a formal addendum. Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood can extend TTL to 90 days for the specific tenant and sessions (scoped exception).
- What evidence/artifacts you can provide to meet SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ expectations for preserved logs (proof-of-retain, restricted access audit, keystore handling).
- A proposed timeline and deliverables (DocuSign-ready addendum + demonstration of audit trail).

Attached: medivance-security-request.pdf and requested-log-sample.csv (examples of session IDs).

We prefer to avoid a full contract amendment if a limited addendum will suffice. Please let us know next steps and an estimated turnaround.

Thanks,
Alice Martin
Head of Security Operations
Medivance Therapeutics

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Alice Martin <alice.martin@medivance.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary preservation of debug logs for incident review

Alice — thanks for the clear ask and the sample CSV. Looping in Ben from Compliance to scope the evidence packet. Quick answers up front:

- Scoped TTL exception: yes, we can implement a tenant-scoped retention extension to 90 days for the listed session IDs. It will be applied as a narrow exception flag in the retention policy (no global policy changes).
- Evidence we can provide: chain-of-custody export (signed manifest), access-control audit showing who accessed the preserved artifacts, and an export proof-of-retention showing timestamps and Keystore record IDs. We can reference the SOC 2 log-preservation controls and attach the CAIQ/SIG mapping for this exception.
- Timeline: draft addendum within 48 business hours; technical change deployed to your tenant within 3 business days after signed addendum; evidence bundle delivered within 5 business days after implementation.

Can you confirm the minimal set of recipients who should have access in Medivance (SecOps only, or broader)? Also confirm whether your legal team needs any additional indemnity language — our standard addendum limits the scope to forensic preservation only.

I will prepare the addendum template and include a DocuSign link for signature.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Alice Martin <alice.martin@medivance.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary preservation of debug logs for incident review

Hi Alice — filling in a few compliance details (quoted below).

On Mon, Nov 30, 2026 at 09:03 AM PDT karthik_iyer@redwood.ai wrote:
> Alice — thanks for the clear ask and the sample CSV. Looping in Ben from Compliance to scope the evidence packet. Quick answers up front:
>
> - Scoped TTL exception: yes, we can implement a tenant-scoped retention extension to 90 days for the listed session IDs. It will be applied as a narrow exception flag in the retention policy (no global policy changes).

Additional notes from Compliance:
- Access model: preserved logs will be stored in an isolated retention bucket with restricted IAM roles (two-person access by default). Any access is logged and immutably timestamped in our audit ledger.
- Keystore/Encryption: objects will remain encrypted with customer-wrapped keys (if configured); Keystore record IDs will be included in the evidence manifest. If Medivance uses Redwood-managed keys, we will provide rotation history for the key used during the preservation window.
- SIG/CAIQ mapping: we will attach the CAIQ control mappings that demonstrate coverage for Log Retention (Class: Logging & Monitoring) and include the relevant SOC 2 control references in the addendum appendix.
- Proof-of-retain: SHA256 manifest + signed timestamp (RFC 3161 style) for the preserved objects.

Action items:
1) Confirm access recipients and whether Medivance will provide a POA for forensic retrieval.
2) Legal: confirm if your legal team requires alternate wording (we can add a 30-day termination notice for the exception).
3) I will attach the CAIQ/SIG mapping and a sample evidence manifest to the DocuSign package.

Attachments: sample-evidence-manifest-template.json (attached to this thread).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Alice Martin <alice.martin@medivance.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary preservation of debug logs for incident review

Thanks — this looks good. A few clarifications from Medivance SecOps & Legal:

- Access recipients: SecOps (alice.martin@medivance.com) + one engineer (sec-eng@medivance.com). Please restrict access to these two addresses only.
- Keys: Medivance uses customer-managed keys via our KMS; please include key rotation history in the evidence.
- Evidence delivery: we need the signed manifest and access audit delivered to legal@medivance.com. PDF preferred.
- Wording: legal is OK with a limited addendum rather than an amendment; they asked for a 14-day notice prior to revoking the exception.

If you can send the DocuSign addendum today, I'll route it internally and aim to sign within 24 hours. Once signed, we will await the technical change and the evidence bundle.

Thanks again — appreciate the turnaround.

Alice Martin
Head of Security Operations
Medivance Therapeutics

PS: attaching the specific session list again for convenience (requested-log-sample.csv).
